# IPinfo: integration analysis

> Generated by API Integration Scout from <https://ipinfo.io/developers> on 2026-10-09T13:32:52.064Z.
> Every finding is marked **Documented** (quoted from the docs and verified), **Inferred** (the agent's reasoning) or **Not found in docs**.

IPinfo is a REST API for IP intelligence: geolocation, ASN, network flags (anonymous, hosting, anycast, mobile, satellite), and more. It has a free Lite tier and paid Core/Plus/Max tiers, plus a batch endpoint and downloadable databases.

## At a glance

| Area | Finding | Status | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base URL | https://api.ipinfo.io | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Authentication | bearer: Bearer token in Authorization header. (+2 documented alternatives) | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Pagination | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Rate limits | Lite unlimited; paid plans have a monthly request quota; no daily/hourly caps, no concurrency limits, no per-second throttling on paid plans. | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Webhooks | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Error format | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Versioning | other | Inferred | [/developers/core-api](https://ipinfo.io/developers/core-api) |
| Endpoints | 6 found | 6 documented, 0 inferred | — |

## Risks

- **MEDIUM**: Two response schemas. Updated (api.ipinfo.io) and legacy (ipinfo.io) shapes differ (nested geo/as vs flat city/loc); pick one deliberately.
- **MEDIUM**: Token in query string. The token is commonly shown as a query parameter, which can leak into logs; prefer the Bearer header server-side.
- **MEDIUM**: Error format undocumented. The fetched pages don't describe error bodies; only 429 and 'error on free tokens' are mentioned.
- **LOW**: Tier gating. /lookup is paid-only; free tokens must use /lite.
- **LOW**: Batch size. Batches are limited to 1,000 items per request.

## Open questions

- What is the JSON error body format and the full list of status codes?
- Are there rate-limit headers or a usage endpoint?
- What is the API versioning and deprecation policy for the legacy ipinfo.io API?
- Are there webhooks or push notifications? None are documented.
